title: Live: Curfews in Paris and other cities helped keep the peace overnight, says French PM
summary: Nighttime curfews came into effect in cities across France, including parts of Paris, Bordeaux, Nice and Lyon, as French police attempted to crack down on rioting and looting during protests. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said further curfews would be imposed Tuesday evening "wherever required". Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
